references.text: The Lord descends on Mount Sinai in a cloud, illustrating the recurring theme of God's presence in the cloud
The pillar of cloud descended and stood at the entrance to the tent when the Lord spoke with Moses
The Lord promises to proclaim His name before Moses, which is fulfilled in this text
The Lord came down in a cloud and spoke with Moses, following the same pattern as Exodus 34:5
The Lord descended in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance to the tent
The Lord appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud
The cloud filled the house of the Lord, demonstrating God's glory and presence in the cloud
Moses called on the name of the Lord, which is connected to the proclamation of God's name
A prayer for God to come down, reflecting the theme of God's descent
A bright cloud overshadowed the disciples on the Mount of Transfiguration, revealing God's presence in the cloud
A cloud took Jesus away from the disciples' sight, the cloud as a sign of God's glory
A recurring motif of God's descent and divine presence in the cloud, highlighting God's intervention.
An identical theological parallel to Psalm 18:10 regarding God descending in a cloud for revelation.
